assumptions: Assume a marked limit line is present; the statute's otherwise cases of stopping before the crosswalk or at the entrance to the intersecting roadway when there is no limit line or crosswalk have no geometry and are omitted.
Assume every vehicle evaluated is approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection; stop-sign presence cannot be seen by the camera.
Assume stop at a limit line means a stopped dwell inside stop_zone, the last 10 metres before the stop line, before crossing the stop line.
Assume stop means continuously stopped with max_speed 0.05 for 1000 ms; the statute states stop with no duration.
Assume inbound crossing over stop_line towards +y corresponds to direction to_right per the line definition.
Assume anchor center is the measured point because boxes are viewed from above and centre is metric position, while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge.
BEFORE is checked with no time limit between stop and crossing.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line must first come to a stop in the stop zone.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
